boating_license.who_requires_it: Anyone born on or after July 1, 1972 operating any mechanically propelled vessel on Maryland waters
boating_license.requirements: Attend all classroom sessions and achieve 80% on final exam

vessel_registration.requirement: All vessels with a motor must be titled and registered with Maryland DNR

registration_card.for_inspection: Must be available for law enforcement inspection

general_requirement.requirement: At least 1 wearable PFD per person onboard

children_under_13.requirement: Must wear Coast Guard-approved life jacket
children_under_13.applies_to: Boats less than 21 feet in length

children_under_4.details: Additional strap secured between child's legs and grab handle for lift assistance

vessels_over_16_feet.additional_requirement: At least one Type IV PFD (ring buoy or seat cushion)

personal_watercraft_pwc.requirement: All PWC occupants must wear a PFD at all times

persons_being_towed.requirement: Must wear Type I, II, III, or V Coast Guard approved PFD

personal_watercraft_pwc_rules.occupants_must_wear: US Coast Guard approved Type I, II, III, or V PFD at all times

boating_under_influence.applies_to: Operating boat while under influence of alcohol or drugs
